interactions.summary: Jiang describes the sudden growth of his YouTube audience and outlines three upcoming free public courses: secret history of the world, great books, and game theory analysis.
The host thanks Jiang and signals a likely return appearance.
Jiang gives a brief final thanks.

claims.claim: Jiang says his sudden YouTube fame arrived while traveling on June 14 and that he was unprepared for the intensity of the response.
claims.temporal_scope: Retrospective personal note made on 2025-08-05 about June 14.

claims.claim: He says his main vocation remains education and that his practice is to upload his courses to YouTube.
Jiang says his upcoming fall course will be on the secret history of the world and will trace how intelligence and religion together shape world history.
claims.temporal_scope: Future course announcement made on 2025-08-05 for the coming fall.

claims.claim: He says spring offerings will include a great-books course for general audiences and a game-theory course designed to teach people how he sees the world.
claims.temporal_scope: Future course announcement made on 2025-08-05 for the following spring.

claims.claim: Jiang says all three near-term courses will be on YouTube and free, though he hopes to build more mature internet courses later.
claims.temporal_scope: Near-term and longer-term plan stated on 2025-08-05.

signature_moments.moment: Jiang narrates viral fame as a before-and-after plane ride: he boarded unknown and landed famous.
signature_moments.source_phrase: when I got off the plane, I was famous
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It is the packet's cleanest image of the channel's sudden public break.

signature_moments.moment: His next flagship offering is described not as geopolitics alone but as the convergence of intelligence and religion across world history.
signature_moments.source_phrase: the convergence of intelligence and religion
signature_moments.why_it_matters: This directly matches the worldview the interview has been building all along.

signature_moments.moment: Jiang promises to teach game theory not just as content but as a way for viewers to learn to think like he does.
signature_moments.source_phrase: learn how to see the world, how to think like I do
signature_moments.why_it_matters: It makes explicit that the real product is Jiang's interpretive lens, not isolated facts.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: Jiang's announced course framing for a world history told through the nexus of intelligence and religion.
Here used as a pedagogical offering that teaches Jiang's interpretive style, not only a technical discipline.

chronology_notes.note: This closing packet dates Jiang's post-viral educational plans to August 2025 and records the announced sequence of fall and spring course offerings.
